books.title: Pri Tzaddik
books.subtitle: Rosh Chodesh to Tu BiShvat
books.scope: Rosh Chodesh · Mar Cheshvan · Kislev · Chanukah · Shevat · Tu BiShvat
books.description: Follow Rav Tzadok HaKohen of Lublin through the renewal of Rosh Chodesh, the hidden light of Chanukah, and the growth of Shevat and Tu BiShvat. Original Hebrew and phrase-by-phrase English appear together, with annotated sources and illuminating parallels.
books.shortDescription: Renewal, hidden light, and spiritual growth through the months and moadim.
books.selectionNote: Title/copyright plus eighteen consecutive opening pages; contents pages omitted. Original printed page numbering preserved.

books.title: Pri Tzaddik
books.subtitle: Kedushas Shabbos & Shevisas Shabbos
books.scope: Opening Teachings · Kedushas Shabbos · Shevisas Shabbos
books.description: Enter Rav Tzadok’s opening teachings and his exploration of the kedushah and menuchah of Shabbos. This interlinear edition keeps the original Hebrew beside a close English translation, with source notes and parallels that help the learner follow each teaching.
books.shortDescription: The opening teachings and Rav Tzadok’s exploration of Shabbos, kedushah, and menuchah.
books.selectionNote: Title/copyright plus eighteen consecutive opening pages; contents pages omitted. Original printed page numbering preserved.
